transcript.user: REI has the Summit GTX boot for $185. Will you match that?
transcript.reply: Thanks for asking! Unfortunately, we don't have a price-matching policy, so I can't match REI's price on the Summit GTX boot. The FALL20 promotion has also ended (it ran October 1–15). If you're a Basecamp Rewards member, you earn 1 point per $1 spent, and every 100 points can be redeemed for $5 off.
